info.cls_ename: SJSU-FCU 2+2 Bachelor's Program in Electrical Engineering

description.describe_ch: This course is a calculus-based introductory level physics course for international or English-oriented students. This course introduces fundamental concepts of electromagnetism in the areas of electric charge distributions, electric potential, electric circuits, magnetic force and field, induction, Maxwell equation and electromagnetic radiation, electromagnetic waves and interferences. Easy Java Simulation and Matlab would be employed for problem solving computationally, visually and numerically.
description.describe_eh: This course is a calculus-based introductory level physics course for international or English-oriented students. This course introduces fundamental concepts of electromagnetism in the areas of electric charge distributions, electric potential, electric circuits, magnetic force and field, induction, Maxwell equation and electromagnetic radiation, electromagnetic waves and interferences. Easy Java Simulation and Matlab would be employed for problem solving computationally, visually and numerically.

targets.describe_ch: To understand most of the natural phenomena in electromagnetism in terms of Maxwell equations and a few other basic principles in physics.
targets.describe_en: To understand most of the natural phenomena in electromagnetism in terms of Maxwell equations and a few other basic principles in physics.

targets.describe_ch: Ability to systematically approach problems in electromagnetism behaving from microscopically to macroscopically with proper terminology
targets.describe_en: Ability to systematically approach problems in electromagnetism behaving from microscopically to macroscopically with proper terminology

targets.describe_ch: Capability to describe simple topics of electromagnetic phenomena graphically and numerically by computational simulations using Easy Java Simulation and Matlab, without intensive training in Mathematics and Programming.
targets.describe_en: Capability to describe simple topics of electromagnetic phenomena graphically and numerically by computational simulations using Easy Java Simulation and Matlab, without intensive training in Mathematics and Programming.

targets.describe_ch: Experience to perform simple physical and virtual experiments in electromagnetism and physical optics, using computers and a variety of physics apparatus, including the gathering, interpretation and analysis of experimental data.
targets.describe_en: Experience to perform simple physical and virtual experiments in electromagnetism and physical optics, using computers and a variety of physics apparatus, including the gathering, interpretation and analysis of experimental data.

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new: Final grade = Lectures (75%) + Lab (25%) Lecture's grade includes 1. Midterm Exam: 20% 2. Final Exam: 25% 3. HW: 20% 4. Class Performance 10% Lab's grade includes Lab. engagement and Lab. reports Students will be marked late or absent on their attendance record if they show up 5 or 15 minutes late, respectively. 最終成績 = 講座 (75%) + 實驗室 (25%) 講座成績包括 1.期中考試：20% 2.期末考試：25% 3.HW：20% 4.課堂表現 10% Lab的成績包括Lab。 參與和實驗室。 報告 如果學生分別遲到 5 分鐘或 15 分鐘，他們的出勤記錄將被標記為遲到或缺席。
